capitalPath.zhCn: Princeton工程教育、机器人、金融软件、对冲基金与Goldman Sachs经历形成技术和金融资本
capitalPath.en: Princeton engineering, robotics, financial software, hedge-fund, and Goldman Sachs work built technical and financial capital

capitalPath.zhCn: 作为Ethereum早期资助者和组织者承担运营与启动资源
capitalPath.en: Served as an early Ethereum funder and organizer supplying operations and launch resources

capitalPath.zhCn: 创立Consensys，通过公司股权、基础设施产品和早期ETH形成财富
capitalPath.en: Founded Consensys and built wealth through company equity, infrastructure products, and early ETH

finding.zhCn: 被广泛认为持有重要配置，但完整数量和出售历史未公开
finding.en: Widely understood to have held a material allocation; full quantity and sale history are unpublished

finding.zhCn: 创始和控制关系明确，完整资本表与个人比例不公开
finding.en: Founding and control are clear; the full cap table and personal percentage are private

finding.zhCn: 2026年9月公告计划拆成两家公司；公司资产仍不等于个人资产或Ethereum协议
finding.en: A September 2026 announcement plans a two-company split; company assets remain distinct from personal assets and the Ethereum protocol

claim.zhCn: Ethereum联合创始人和早期资助者

finding.en: Confirmed by Ethereum's official history and Consensys records

claim.en: Controls Ethereum because Consensys controls MetaMask

finding.zhCn: 错误；钱包与RPC基础设施影响不等于协议所有权
finding.en: Incorrect; wallet and RPC infrastructure influence is not protocol ownership

claim.zhCn: 2026年出任 MetaMask 董事长兼 CEO，并任新 Consensys 执行董事长
claim.en: Became MetaMask chairman and CEO and executive chairman of the new Consensys in 2026

finding.zhCn: 2026年9月9日公司公告确认职务计划，预计年底完成；未披露个人股权
finding.en: The September 9, 2026 company announcement confirms the planned roles, expected to complete by year-end, and does not disclose personal equity

openQuestions.zhCn: 其创世ETH配置、出售、质押和当前钱包是多少？
openQuestions.en: What were his genesis ETH allocation, sales, staking, and current wallets?

openQuestions.zhCn: Consensys历轮融资后个人股权、质押和负债是多少？
openQuestions.en: What are his ownership, pledges, and liabilities after Consensys financing rounds?

summary.zhCn: 补入2026年9月9日 Consensys 拆分为 MetaMask 与新 Consensys 的职务安排，并保持公司资产与个人财富分开。
summary.en: Added the September 9, 2026 plan to split Consensys into MetaMask and a new Consensys, while keeping company assets separate from personal wealth.
